{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool blend overcoat in charcoal gray (#3d3d3d), tailored straight cut with a knee-length hem to block the snow and frost.
Merino wool turtleneck sweater in cream beige (#f5f1e8), slim fit that provides necessary warmth without bulk during the twenty-minute walk.
High-rise dark denim trousers in indigo (#1a2b45), classic straight leg with reinforced stitching to withstand wet road conditions.
Water-resistant leather ankle boots in black (#0d0d0d) featuring a modest heel and deep tread for safe traction on salted sidewalks.
Gold-tone minimal stud earrings and a slim silver watch in matte finish.

This outfit prioritizes genuine warmth against the freezing, snowy weather while adhering to your request for "neat" professional attire suitable for work. The heavy coat and thick wool layers ensure you stay cozy during your twenty-minute walk without looking overly bulky or dressed up for the occasion. Darker tones like charcoal and indigo are practical choices that hide any potential road salt stains, while the refined textures of the knitwear and leather elevate the look to meet a professional dress code."}
